title: fix(plugin-grid): a date-family min / max reads as its cell in the group header and the column footer, never NaN
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRPYM3spC6U3EaMPUoU2DrL)_

Fixes #32119

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the exported `AggregationResult` gains an optional `display` string; `value` keeps its `number | null` type and, for a date-family `min` / `max`, now carries the extreme's instant in epoch milliseconds instead of `NaN` (server-grouped) or `0` (grouped in hand). `ColumnSummaryResult` keeps its shape: `label` carries the formatted time, `value` the same instant (it carried the parsed year).
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：分组表格表头里对日期/日期时间字段的 `min` / `max` 聚合，以及列脚汇总的 `min` / `max`，现在按该字段单元格的显示方式（格式、语言）显示时间，不再显示 `NaN` 或年份数字；对日期字段的 `sum` / `avg` 直接不显示。
- 为什么改：cloud 的 SCIM 控制台「每个连接的最近同步」表头显示 `max: NaN`（cloud#4278 的阻塞项）；列脚同类问题显示成 `Max: 2,026`。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@object-ui/plugin-grid` 的渲染层，导出类型只加了一个可选字段；纯数字聚合输出不变（原有钉子全绿）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useGroupedData.ts`（服务端读值 `readServerAggregations` 与客户端 `computeAggregations`）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts`（列脚的日期分支）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/temporalCellFace.ts`（从分组模块挪出的唯一格式器）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupDateHeading-13234.test.tsx`，预期全绿；或看下方截图：修复前表头 `max: NaN`、列脚 `Max: 2,026`，修复后与单元格同一写法。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Group header, server path.** `readServerAggregations` cast every header-query summary through `Number(value)`. A `min` / `max` column holds the aggregated field's stored value, which for a `date` / `datetime` field is text (measured on a live boot: `"max_created_at":"2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z"`, `"min_due_date":"2026-12-05"`), so the header drew `max: NaN`. A date-family `min` / `max` is now read as its instant and drawn through the field's cell face; any other answer that is not a finite number is left out (never `NaN`).
- **Group header, in-hand path.** `computeAggregations` mapped rows through `Number(...)`, dropped every stored time as non-finite and drew `0`. A date-family `min` / `max` now takes the row whose stored value names the earliest / latest instant and draws that value through the cell face; a group with no time in it answers `null` (a dash). Numeric aggregates are unchanged, including the pinned null-as-0 coercion (`gridAggregationMembers-8071`).
- **`sum` / `avg` over a date-family field** is dropped in `useObjectGridGrouping` beside the ADR-0144 money-aggregate drop, before either path computes it and before the header query is compiled, so the server is never asked to add up times.
- **`GroupRow`** draws `display` when the result carries one, and a dash for a value that is not a finite number.
- **Column footer (the same defect, measured).** `useScopedColumnSummary` read a date column's cells with `parseFloat`, so an ISO instant became its year (`Max: 2,026`, on both the rows path and the whole-set server figure). A `min` / `max` over a column whose cell paints a date-family face now draws the extreme time through the same face; a `sum` / `avg` over one draws no figure.
- **One face resolve, one formatter.** The date-family face selection and formatter that the group headings already used (`temporalGroupHeading`, objectui#13234) moved verbatim out of `objectGridGrouping.ts` into `temporalCellFace.ts` (`temporalCellFaceOf`, `temporalCellText`), with the instant read and extreme pick beside them. The group heading, the header `min` / `max` and the footer `min` / `max` all call it; no date is formatted anywhere new.
- **Published surface.** `AggregationResult.display?: string` is added (Clause-② widening); `useGroupedData`'s signature is unchanged. The package-internal `useGroupedDataInOptionOrder` gains an optional trailing `temporalAggregates` hand-off (faces plus display locale), which `ObjectGrid` builds. The published hook knows no field types, so there a server `min` / `max` answered as text is left out rather than drawn as `NaN`.

## Tests

New pins go into the existing shared harness files (ruling record 6583487846), as top-level describes:

- `groupDateHeading-13234.test.tsx` — on BOTH the server-grouped and the client-grouped grid: a `datetime` `max` reads exactly the Closed At cell of each group's latest row, for formats unset / `relative` / `short` / `YYYY-MM-DD`, and never matches `NaN` or a raw ISO instant; a `date` `min` reads the Period Start cell of the earliest row (unset / `relative` / `YYYY-MM-DD`); `sum` / `avg` over the datetime field are absent while a numeric `max` beside them stands, and the server is not asked for them; CONTROL: numeric `min` / `avg` print as before (`80.50`, `100.38`, `300`, `600`). Plus the published `useGroupedData`: a server `max` answered as text is left out, a numeric one stands.
- `footerSummaryScope-12081.test.tsx` — rows handed in whole: the footer `max` is the latest row's Closed At cell, not `2,025`; own fetch over 300 rows paged by 25: the whole set's `max` (the double answers stored text, as a SQL driver does) reads as the last row's cell rendered in a one-row grid; `sum` over a datetime column draws no figure; CONTROL: a number column's `max` still reads `1,000`.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over every touched file: `useGroupedData.ts` carries objectui#7189 ruling A (server grouping reads the header query) and objectui#10881 ruling F (no in-hand grouping of a fetched page) — both kept: the date read sits inside the header-query reader; `useColumnSummary.ts` carries ruling 乙 on objectstack#19910, ruling B on objectstack#19629 and ruling A′ on objectstack#19628 (footer widths) — untouched arms; `ObjectGrid.tsx` carries many hits, and this diff changes only its import of the moved formatter.
- No `packages/spec/**`, server or cloud change: the header query already answers the right value (measured above). Refusing `sum` / `avg` over a non-numeric field at parse is spec work and is not built here: `object-grid.aggregations[]` declares `field` as a bare string, so the spec cannot see the field's type at that door. Reported to the seat.
- The spec's `deriveColumnSummary` is typed `number | null | undefined`, while a `min` / `max` column it reads back carries the stored value (text for a date-family field). The reader here types it `unknown`; the spec type is reported, not changed.
- A `sum` / `avg` over a text field is still computed as before (in-hand `0`, pinned by `gridAggregationMembers-8071`); only date-family fields are dropped, because only their faces are known to the grid.
- The footer's numeric arms are byte-identical in behaviour; the label join moved into `joinSummaryLabel`, which `formatSummaryLabel` calls.

## Verification

Final head: `09fa8102` (every reading below is on it unless it says otherwise).

<details><summary>Browser — dev boot (showcase, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`) plus the Console's Vite dev server; before = this branch with the five grid sources restored from origin/main and Vite restarted with --force (served code checked)</summary>

A page with an `object-grid` over `showcase_task`, `grouping: { fields: [{ field: 'status' }] }` and `aggregations: [{ field: 'created_at', type: 'max' }, { field: 'due_date', type: 'min' }, { field: 'estimate_hours', type: 'max' }]`, and a second one with footer summaries on the same three columns.

- Before, group header: `Backlog 2 max: NaN min: NaN max: 18` (every group).
- After, group header: `Backlog 2 max: 11/9/2026 12:00 am min: Dec 5 max: 18`, the Created cell of that group's latest row reading `11/9/2026 12:00 am` and its Due Date cell `Dec 5`.
- Before, footer: `Created: Max: 2,026` · `Due Date: Min: 2,026` · `Estimate (h): Max: 60`.
- After, footer: `Created: Max: 11/9/2026 12:00 am` · `Due Date: Min: Oct 23` · `Estimate (h): Max: 60`.

Shots (project files): `ui-orders/32119-shots/grouped-header-before.png`, `grouped-header-after.png`, `footer-before.png`, `footer-after.png`.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests and type-check</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` at `09fa8102`, under `os-verify-lock`: Test Files 278 passed (278), Tests 2420 passed (2420).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) at `09fa8102`: exit 0.
- An earlier full run at `bcda5dbf` went red on three `gridAggregationMembers-8071` pins (a generic "no number, left out" rule on the in-hand path changed the pinned null-as-0 coercion); `09fa8102` takes that rule back out and keeps only the date-family arm, and the run above is green.
- No other package imports `AggregationResult`, `ColumnSummaryResult`, `useGroupedData` or `useColumnSummary` (only comments in `plugin-kanban` and `types` name them), so no downstream type-check is owed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

Mutation at `09fa8102`: in `readServerAggregations`, the date-family arm `const result = temporalAggregateOf(field, type, value, temporal!, face); if (result) out.push(result);` replaced by `out.push({ field, type, value: Number(value) as number });` (the pre-fix cast). The script reported `anchor 1 -> 0`, replacement `0 -> 1`, blob `79b60522f3a0 -> 72acb99d1f18`.

- Run: the server-grouped date-family describe in `groupDateHeading-13234.test.tsx` — Tests 7 failed | 2 passed: every `datetime` `max` and `date` `min` pin went red, with `Received: "max: —"` / `"min: —"` (the `NaN` the cast produces now reaches `GroupRow`'s dash, so the pin needs the formatted time, not just the absence of `NaN`). The two that stayed green are the `sum` / `avg` and the numeric CONTROL pins, which the mutation does not touch.
- Restore: blob back to `79b60522f3a0` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty (the script's own check, repeated by hand).
- No build step is involved: the suite imports `../useGroupedData` from source.
</details>
